explanation: For t≠1, the summed force simplifies to ⟨10/(t+1),10t⟩, so a(t)=⟨2/(t+1),2t⟩ and v(t)=⟨2ln(t+1),t²−1⟩ using the initial velocity. Its continuous limit at t=1 is ⟨2ln(2),0⟩, giving speed 2ln(2), option b. However, both stated individual forces are undefined at t=1, so this answer requires interpreting the requested velocity by continuous extension.
